start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-my-private-reactions with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and reactions [{\"record\": \"file:private\", \"symbol\": \"heart\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the reactions are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-my-private-reactions" with store and the reactions to keep. Give part only when the reaction is on one part of the thing.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every attempt must be kept, repeated or refused as the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the new reactions through those objects and reads them back for the person only.
